## 6. Function

Implement exactly this behaviour (from the reference program's documentation):

```text
Prompt sections shared by the generation-prompt builders
  (make_ip_prompts.py for every IP / system / example prompt,
  make_system_prompt.py for new systems), so every prompt states the same
  rules: implementation formatting (one statement per line, one parameter
  and one port per line in instantiations), the file header template
  (read from ip/docs/HEADER_TEMPLATE.txt), clocks / resets / clock-domain
  crossing techniques, the design guidelines (summary here, complete in
  ip/docs/DESIGN_GUIDELINES.md, plus an optional guidelines CSV: column 1
  guideline, 2 mandatory, 3 optional, 4 notes; read_guidelines_csv), the
  tools for every step, code coverage
  targets (100 % by default) and the tests a simulation script can run
  (ip/scripts/list_tests.py). Each function returns Markdown lines.
```

Per function:

```text
formatting_constraints: Implementation-constraint bullets on code layout (enforced by ip/scripts/sv_format.py).

flag: A mandatory / optional cell is set by any mark (x, yes, y, 1, true, a tick ...), not by "", 0, no, false, -.

resolve: A file as given (relative to the current directory), else relative to the repository root.

read_guidelines_csv: Guidelines from a CSV file: column 1 guideline, column 2 mandatory, column 3 optional, column 4 notes.
Mandatory / optional are marks (see flag). A first row whose first cell is "guideline" (any case, plural
too) is a header; empty rows and rows starting with # are skipped; missing cells are empty; a UTF-8
BOM (Excel) is accepted. A row marked both mandatory and optional counts as mandatory; a row with
neither is unclassified. Warnings go to stderr.

guidelines_csv_section: Markdown for a guidelines CSV: mandatory, optional and (if any) unclassified guidelines, with notes.

guidelines_section: The guidelines summary; plus the guidelines CSV (csv_path, else the builder's guidelines_csv) when set.

default_guidelines_csv: The guidelines CSV to use: the one given (must exist), else GUIDELINES_CSV when it exists, else None.

tests_section: The tests the simulation script can run (from the design's test files), and how to list them.
```
